planets.name: K2-315 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-315 with a 3.14-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: K2-315 b was found in 2020 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-315. Its orbit and size follow Niraula et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname NIRAULA_ET_AL__2020): disc_year 2020, disc_facility K2, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 3.1443189, pl_radj 0.08475332, pl_bmassj 0.00254

quotes.title: K2-315b
quotes.card: K2-315b is an exoplanet located 185.3 light-years away from Earth in the southern zodiac constellation Libra.
quotes.introduction: It orbits the red dwarf K2-315.
